schema_ddl: CREATE TABLE authors (id INT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE books (id INT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, author_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES authors(id)); CREATE TABLE loans (id INT PRIMARY KEY, book_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES books(id), loan_date DATE NOT NULL);

workload.query_text: SELECT a.name, COUNT(*) FROM authors a JOIN books b ON b.author_id = a.id GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
SELECT b.title, COUNT(l.id) AS loan_count FROM books b LEFT JOIN loans l ON l.book_id = b.id GROUP BY b.title HAVING COUNT(l.id) > 0 ORDER BY loan_count DESC
